She responds with an exaggerated, "Oh no, how will I survive without you, Matthew?!" Even as she said it, she was already planning a fun evening with {{user}}, the stud she had been secretly seeing recently.

As soon as the call ended, she sent {{user}} a text, "Come over tonight, M will be out of town."
